scope: Exact prior review references, preserved repair history and authenticated browser acceptance

databases.externalProviders: disabled; acceptance fetch restricted to loopback

acceptanceChecks: Exact new member contexts receive numeric prior decision references but remain pending; member access to RND case data is denied
Different age, weight, goal and changed clinical keys do not use approximate matching
Original review context remains fixed after its member changes profile; old private guidance and member identity are excluded from the reference DTO
Changed side quantities, food composition revisions and source extended nutrients invalidate serving references
Quarantine, expired decision reviewer credentials and disputed source decisions exclude references; legacy context is never reconstructed
Current claims, strict fields, 21 simultaneous meal claims, late answers, successor resolution and related audited admin access remain enforced
Actual profile changes retire outdated requests while preserving logs and signed historical decisions; current acknowledgment and profile confirmation remain mandatory
Concurrent current-cycle repair publishes one remaining-four-day cycle with ten fresh meals and two retained slots without a new admission charge
One eaten and one skipped slot retain their original logs; the eaten DTO uses its recorded 650 kcal rather than the old meal plan's 700 kcal
Previous purchases remain unchanged and read-only, without automatic pantry credit; current groceries cover only fresh cleared meals
Inherited history is captured once; changed purchases fail the final transaction history guard; recovery does not regenerate retained slots
Upcoming preparation cannot supersede the repaired current cycle before its recorded end date
Foreign-member history is unavailable; reauthenticated deletion cascades through forms, review epochs and repair receipts

browser.runner: Chromium Playwright against localhost:3000, all API requests forwarded to authenticated task-owned backends
browser.memberMatrix: 390px and 1440px, each in light and dark mode; dashboard intake/history, meals history and previous grocery purchases
browser.rndJourney: Desktop exact references, claimed fullscreen canvas, local Ctrl-wheel zoom, H/V tools, published questions, live return to default panel, member response and another RND's Profile queue handoff
browser.authentication: Real API role/claim enforcement with synthetic signed sessions; no interactive login journey
browser.limits: Browser checks do not establish every proposal/dispute flow; those remain covered by earlier HTTP and component evidence. Admin case access is checked by HTTP, not a newly claimed admin browser journey.

staticChecks.sourceArchitecture: Changed source modules meet their budgets. Global check reports existing unchanged clinical-evidence.service.ts at 901 lines (limit 900), also present in baseline HEAD 8884ca9c.
